body_md:
Seven general contractors with Fort Myers addresses are listed here after a check of Florida DBPR licensee records. Every license in this set is Current, Active and expires on 08/31/2028. Compare the service area, license type, hours, and described work below to the city and project you have in mind.

## How we picked

These seven are the full set in the source data, each listed as a general contractor. License type, number, status, and expiration come from the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and each listing's source is that results page. Unknown fields, including prices, are left unknown.

## At a glance

- License type: Olde Florida Contracting, Inc. (CGC1517029), Kelly General Contracting LLC (CGC1528270), Sunset Builders & Maintenance, Inc. (CGC1533659), Tri-Town Construction LLC (CGC1512714), Fluharty-Monroe Construction Inc. (CGC061290), and Thomas Cook General Contracting, Inc. (CGC018340) are Certified General Contractor. Alliance Construction & Renovations Inc is Certified Building Contractor (CBC1268590). All seven are Current, Active, with expiration 08/31/2028.
- Service area on file: Olde Florida Contracting, Inc. is registered with Lee County, City of Fort Myers, City of Bonita Springs, City of Cape Coral, City of Sanibel, Town of Fort Myers Beach, Village of Estero, Collier County, City of Naples, City of Marco Island, Hendry County, City of Clewiston, City of LaBelle, and Charlotte County. Alliance Construction & Renovations Inc lists Fort Myers, Punta Gorda, Cape Coral, North Fort Myers, Estero, Bonita Springs, Naples, and nearby cities. Kelly General Contracting LLC lists Lee and Collier counties, including Fort Myers, Fort Myers Beach, Sanibel, Captiva, Bonita Springs, Estero, Naples, Cape Coral, and North Fort Myers. Sunset Builders & Maintenance, Inc. lists Sanibel and Captiva Islands, Fort Myers, Fort Myers Beach, and Cape Coral. Tri-Town Construction LLC lists Fort Myers, Naples, Cape Coral, Bonita Springs, Estero, Marco Island, Sanibel, Fort Myers Beach, and broader Lee and Collier counties. Fluharty-Monroe Construction Inc. lists Southwest Florida. Thomas Cook General Contracting, Inc. has service area unknown.
- Described work: Olde Florida Contracting, Inc. lists construction management for commercial and custom residential projects, custom homes, and dealer status for StarMark and Mantra cabinets. Alliance Construction & Renovations Inc lists whole-home renovations, additions, kitchens, bathrooms, and structural work. Kelly General Contracting LLC lists renovations, additions, new construction, custom homes, design-build, and commercial tenant improvements. Tri-Town Construction LLC lists custom homes, ICF construction, and full-scope remodels. Fluharty-Monroe Construction Inc. lists concrete and masonry, custom homes, and commercial buildings. A services list is not in the facts for Thomas Cook General Contracting, Inc.
- Hours on file: Alliance Construction & Renovations Inc lists Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM and Saturday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, and a showroom at 11751 Metro Pkwy STE 1 for in-person material selections. Sunset Builders & Maintenance, Inc. lists field work Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–4:30 PM and may start at 7:00 AM. Hours are unknown for the other five.

## Things to know before you go

Match the city of the job to the service-area line for that business before you call. Dollar prices are unknown for all seven. Sunset Builders & Maintenance, Inc. states a lump-sum price, a ballpark estimate on the initial visit, and a design-agreement process for an agreed cost before work starts, plus a full bathroom remodel often 3 to 5 weeks and a full kitchen remodel often 4 to 8 weeks. Tri-Town Construction LLC states a 3-year workmanship warranty on the company site. Kelly General Contracting LLC lists (239) 910-6377, and the site also lists (239) 243-8930, plus email Ryan@KellyGC.com.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses current?

Each of the seven is Current, Active on the Florida DBPR licensee lookup and expires 08/31/2028. Numbers are CGC1517029, CBC1268590, CGC1528270, CGC1533659, CGC1512714, CGC061290, and CGC018340. Each listing's source is its DBPR results page.

### What years are noted?

Tri-Town Construction LLC is noted since 2006; Olde Florida Contracting, Inc. since 2009; Sunset Builders & Maintenance, Inc. founded July 2009; Fluharty-Monroe Construction Inc. established 2010; Kelly General Contracting LLC since 2020; Alliance Construction & Renovations Inc incorporated October 18, 2021. Thomas Cook General Contracting, Inc. shows a license licensure date of March 11, 1981, and a Florida profit corporation filed August 10, 1999.

### Are prices listed?

Dollar prices are unknown for all seven.
